title: Tours from Lahore to northern Pakistan
description: Guided group and private tours from Lahore to Hunza, Skardu, Swat, Naran-Kaghan, Fairy Meadows and Murree, with local guides and experienced drivers. Plan your trip on WhatsApp.

hero.lead: Guided group and private tours from Lahore to Hunza, Skardu and the valleys in between.

image.alt: Snow-covered Rakaposhi above the Hunza valley at sunset, with golden autumn poplars below

statement.headline: Guides from Hunza and Skardu, drivers who know every bend of the Karakoram Highway
statement.body: Our guides grew up in Hunza, Skardu and Swat. Our drivers have spent decades on the Karakoram Highway. They plan around the weather, the roads and your family’s pace, so all you have to do is look out of the window.

departures.headline: Upcoming group departures
departures.note: Prices per person, twin sharing. Every departure leaves from Lahore.
